test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.1.**
solution:
The correct answer is "**promise**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **theme **of the passage is the** significance of childhood**. The right nurturing in childhood will lead to a life of greatness and success.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of given words.
 
• **Promise**: a declaration or assurance that one will do something or that a particular thing will happen.
 
• **Bond**: a relationship between people or groups based on shared feelings, interests, or experiences.
 
• **Contract**: a written or spoken agreement, especially one concerning employment, sales, or tenancy, that is intended to be enforceable by law.
 
• **Plight**: a dangerous, difficult, or otherwise unfortunate situation.
 
 
• **Example**: *Rajeev has a **promising **__career in music.*
 
 

**The complete passage is:-** *The child is the father of man. Childhood is a **(1) __promise__**__ __of what one is going to be when one **(2)__attains__**__ __maturity. The natural instincts of a man are **(3)__determined__**__ __in his childhood. Time modifies them but cannot **(4)__efface__**__ __them. History contains numerous examples of great men who gave **(5)__indications__**__ __of their future when they were children. A child’s mind is **(6)****__impressionable____ __and flexible. The mould he receives before his clay **(7)__hardens__** becomes his permanent mark. The values and standards of **(8)__conduct__**__ __which will determine his life as a man **(9)__are developed__**__ __in childhood itself. There may be certain **(10)__exceptions__**__ __of course. A bright morning may end in a storm!*
